text:
Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor Launch Trailer
Leave it to luck? Not a chance.

Man of Honor, a Mafia: The Old Country expansion, is available now for XBOX Series X|S:

► Play now: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/mafia-the-old-country-man-of-honor/9NMK0JGPHHT6

Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Continue Enzo's story across two new chapters, featuring fresh environments, weapons, vehicles, and Charms. In new DLC content for Free Ride mode, team up with Salieri to earn big by taking on a new set of exclusive jobs and extreme challenges, and discover new collectibles and hidden locations as you explore. 

#MafiaGame #MafiaTheOldCountry

text:
Battlefield 6 X Top Gun: Carrier Strike Cinematic Trailer
Play Top Gun in Season 4 for free starting August 18

Take to the skies and become the best of the best. The Top Gun update arrives in Battlefield 6 on August 18, bringing high-speed aerial combat, legendary battlefields, and new ways to dominate the Pacific.

Pilot the new F/A-81F Super Spectre and F-74A Seacat two-seat fighter jets with your wingman, master intense dogfights in Gauntlet: Fighter Sweep, and fight across land, sea, and air in the reimagined Carrier Strike. Return to the iconic Wake Island, rebuilt for Battlefield 6 with large-scale combined-arms combat across its beaches, bunkers, and surrounding waters.

Complete event challenges to earn Top Gun-themed rewards and unlock the Interdictor, Battlefield 6's longest-range sniper rifle, through the Battle Pass.

The update also expands Tsuru Reef with playable aircraft carriers, bringing the reimagined Carrier Strike experience to Battlefield's biggest map yet.
